captions.instagram:
A 5-minute heart scan for $99. 💙

A calcium score is a quick CT scan that measures calcium plaque in the arteries of your heart, one of the strongest predictors of future heart attack risk.

✔️ $99 self-pay, no referral needed
✔️ No needles and no contrast: small stickers on your chest and a few seconds of breath-holding
✔️ Low-dose CT, about 1 mSv
✔️ A radiologist sends your score to you and your doctor in 48 to 72 hours
✔️ Skip caffeine for 4 hours before; no fasting needed

It's often used for adults 40 to 75 with high cholesterol, high blood pressure, diabetes, a smoking history or a family history of heart disease, especially when you're unsure about starting a statin. Heart groups (ACC/AHA) support it for some adults; the USPSTF says the evidence isn't enough to screen everyone. Ask your doctor if it's right for you.

📌 Save this to remember what your score means.

📅 Book through the link in our bio or call (727) 398-5999. At our Seminole center.

Having chest pain now? Call 911. General information, not medical advice.

captions.gbp:
A 5-minute heart scan for $99 at Advanced Medical Imaging in Seminole. A calcium score is a quick CT scan that measures calcium plaque in the arteries of your heart, one of the strongest predictors of future heart attack risk. It costs $99 self-pay with no referral needed. There are no needles and no contrast: small stickers on your chest time the pictures with your heartbeat, you hold your breath for a few seconds, and you're done in about 5 minutes. It's a low-dose CT, about 1 mSv. A radiologist sends your score to you and your doctor in 48 to 72 hours. A score of 0 means no calcium plaque was detected; higher scores mean more plaque. It's often used for adults 40 to 75 with high cholesterol, high blood pressure, diabetes, a smoking history or a family history of heart disease. Heart groups (ACC/AHA) support it for some adults, while the USPSTF says the evidence isn't enough to screen everyone, so ask your doctor if it's right for you. Skip caffeine for 4 hours before; no fasting needed.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.
